decisions.reason: Restricting the selectable color palette does not change the required green color of the level-9 bullet or any bullet sizing, alignment, or scaling behavior.
The color-option restriction does not affect Board Meeting field alignment.
The color-option restriction does not affect row insertion or unintended border behavior.
The color-option restriction does not change the calendar-based date field or its template contexts.
The color-option restriction does not affect automatic placeholder clearing or field activation.
The color-option restriction does not affect text wrapping or adjacent-column stability.
The color-option restriction does not affect fixed margins or visibility of the pencil icon.
The color-option restriction does not affect multiline entry or the use of standard Enter.
The color-option restriction does not alter hard-return spacing for continuous text.
The general obligation to implement the specified style catalog remains unchanged; palette-option control is owned by the separate theme-color Requirement.
The color-option restriction does not alter style prefixes, naming coverage, conditions, or language.
The color-option restriction does not change caption targets, typography, or the caption style name.
